headline: Obama order creates a Global Engagement Center to coordinate U.S. government counterterrorism messaging aimed at audiences abroad.
what_it_does: This order sets up a Global Engagement Center to lead and coordinate communications across federal agencies that are meant to counter terrorist messaging outside the United States. It also cancels Executive Order 13584, an earlier 2011 order on counterterrorism communications. No summary was provided, so details about the center's structure, funding, and powers are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that do counterterrorism communications overseas
who_it_affects.how: Their messaging work aimed at foreign audiences is to be coordinated through the new Global Engagement Center.
